question: As per 2011 Census Hindus form 79.80% with a population of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**over 90 crores**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the 2011 Census of India, the population of India was approximately **1.21 billion (1,210 million) **out of which 79.80% form Hindus.
 
• **Regional Distribution** of Hindu population: They is widespread across India, with significant concentrations in states like:
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh
 
• Maharashtra
 
• Bihar
 
• West Bengal
 
• Madhya Pradesh
 
• Rajasthan
 
 
 
• **Cultural Diversity**: Hinduism encompasses a wide range of beliefs, practices, and sects, including:
 
 
• Shaivism
 
• Shaktism
 
• Vaishnavism
 
• Smarta tradition
 
 
 
• **Festivals and Practices**: Hinduism is known for its rich tapestry of festivals such as:
 
 
• Diwali (Festival of Lights)
 
• Holi (Festival of Colors)
 
• Navratri (Worship of Goddess Durga)
 
• Raksha Bandhan (Celebrating the bond between brothers and sisters)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Hinduism** is the majority religion, making up 79.80% of the population.
 
• **Islam** is the second-largest religion, with 14.23% of the population.
 
• **Christianity** is the third-largest religion, constituting 2.30% of the population.
 
• **Sikhism** is the fourth-largest religion, making up 1.72% of the population.
 
• **Other** **religions** like Buddhism, Jainism, and other smaller groups make up less than 1% each.
